positions.name: RememberAsyncJobContract
positions.frame: how is the remember async job contract structured across dispatch, polling, and reaction delivery?
positions.why: Both expressions define the operational contract and lifecycle of asynchronous remember operations: src-1 establishes the ratified receipt-and-cursor polling model ensuring non-blocking execution and durability against dropped receipts, while src-2 details the dispatch mechanism and dual retrieval paths (polling versus piggybacked reactions).
